integrity: Cubic complex normal-form coefficients and the unique minimizer were reconstructed symbolically using the included checker; periodic-orbit shooting is optional corroboration. Correctness, originality and value underwent self-review only; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local, pointwise Hopf-cycle asymptotics of the physical-time homogeneous two-variable Gray–Scott ODE. No global-cycle, reaction-diffusion, or parameter-path period monotonicity. A historical 1984 article was accessible through its abstract but not its complete text, so publication priority is not conclusively established. The indexed 1984-01-01 date may represent year-level bibliographic normalization.
title: A sharp minimum for nonlinear period softening along the Gray–Scott Hopf curve
